name: Reliable Autonomous Neural Plan Discovery
hypothesis: Replacing discrete exact-match sequence filtering with normalized sequence log-likelihood S(P) enables reliable neural plan selection (>=70% plan accuracy, >=30% end-to-end exact match) while preserving specificity (>=95% rejection on uncomposable tasks) and reducing false abstention on supported composable tasks (<=30% at N=4), with strictly zero parameter growth and zero compound training steps.
architectural_principle: Adaptive Mini-GPT should learn before growing, reuse before learning, and verify before retaining any change.

evaluation_design.statistical_model: Paired Student-t test (df=4, t_crit=2.776 at 95% two-tailed)
